		Dataset Summary
	

SA-Med3D-140K is a large-scale, multi-modal, multi-anatomical volumetric medical image segmentation dataset. It was created to facilitate the development of general-purpose foundation models for 3D medical image segmentation. 
The dataset comprises 21,729 3D medical images and 143,518 corresponding masks. 
It was gathered from a combination of 70 public datasets and 8,128 privately licensed annotated cases from 24 hospitals.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/blsmash044/SA-Med3D-140K.
